text: Their airborne battalion has landed behind us. Air cavalry is attached. Find them, pin them, and clear the landing zones before they link up with the main body.
speaker: Ryan
instruction: Calm, clipped US Army staff officer briefing a commander over a field radio; steady, serious, unhurried.
